objective: Qualify four adjacent phrases for existing FastAPI/pytest retrieval without adding families or relaxing semantic selection.

locks.provider_ablation: NOT_APPLICABLE: only query normalization changes; semantic frontends and provider configuration remain identical.

corpora.scope: complete tracked source snapshot; do not select only backend files

evidence_policy.primary: Unchanged 110-query development corpus gains are reported separately from the prospective public-repository queries. Every false family or selection on abstention gold is a safety failure.
evidence_policy.public_gold: These are intent labels frozen before product outcomes. Family absence, conservative ambiguity, or unresolved semantic obligations remain recorded misses; never change gold or weaken selection to manufacture hits.
evidence_policy.family_invariance: Compare complete old/candidate family inventories, IDs, support, and source-evidence projections on byte-identical inputs; the expected newly created family count is zero.
evidence_policy.payload_delta: Keep raw payload hashes and bytes. The sole predeclared unchanged-query delta is query vocabulary metadata v2 to v3; exact JSON paths must be frozen before candidate output is inspected.
evidence_policy.provider_state: Record the existing absent optional providers; a label-only structural/no-provider condition is not an ablation.
evidence_policy.baseline_control: The existing token-overlap control is a diagnostic lower bound. Its route-match counts and in-process latency are not comparable to product subprocess measurements.
evidence_policy.claim_limit: This is a narrow prospective phrase/context check, not a sealed independent-author benchmark, arbitrary-language support, whole-Top-20 completion, agent adoption, or measured token savings. The evaluator saw the historical development corpus; FastAPI content is previously used.
